# ADR-3051: A05: Unnecessary feature toggle for service profile 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Extra features expand attack surface.

## Decision

Hardened profiles MUST disable each unnecessary feature toggle for service profile 3 (A05-3).

## Consequences

Baselines are versioned per runtime.
